CaptureRead.description: A page sent by the browser extension, waiting on « Nouvel article ».
CaptureRead.title: CaptureRead

CategoryUpdate.description: Name and order only: the code is immutable (item codes depend on it).
CategoryUpdate.title: CategoryUpdate

ChoiceUpdate.description: Label and order only: the code is kept by articles, envelopes and professionals.
ChoiceUpdate.title: ChoiceUpdate

ClientUpdate.description: Absent = unchanged; explicit null = cleared (nullable fields only).
ClientUpdate.title: ClientUpdate

FileSave.description: One file of the article as it must be after the save (already uploaded by `POST /files`).
FileSave.title: FileSave

InstallationArticle.description: A placement as the sheet shows it: its code, its article and its photo.
InstallationArticle.title: InstallationArticle

InstallationLayout.description:
A page's grid (`ffe.installation.layout`): column widths and row heights in px of the A3
page, the block the plan spans, the article cells in reading order.
InstallationLayout.title: InstallationLayout

InstallationMarker.description: A numbered dot on the plan, in thousandths of the plan as stored (before any rotation).
InstallationMarker.title: InstallationMarker

InstallationSheetItemsSet.description:
The sheet's cells in order, saved at once: an article and its dots on the plan, or null
for a cell left empty.
InstallationSheetItemsSet.title: InstallationSheetItemsSet

ItemSave.description:
« Enregistrer » on the article page: every change at once, one transaction (all or nothing).
Absent = unchanged; `placements` and `files` are the full lists wanted.
ItemSave.title: ItemSave

LineAmountsRead.description: Amounts of one article, computed by `money.py`, never stored.
LineAmountsRead.title: LineAmountsRead

OptionAttach.description: An existing article of the project becomes an option of the base (ADR-0021).
OptionAttach.title: OptionAttach

PlacementAmountRead.description: EUR share of one placement (quantity × multiplier at the net unit price).
PlacementAmountRead.title: PlacementAmountRead

PlacementSave.description: One placement of the article as it must be after the save: `id` = kept, none = new.
PlacementSave.title: PlacementSave

ProjectItemCreate.description: The whole sheet is typed here (ADR-0016: no catalogue).
ProjectItemCreate.title: ProjectItemCreate

ProjectItemUpdate.description: Absent = unchanged. `status` never here (POST …/status), placements have their own routes.
ProjectItemUpdate.title: ProjectItemUpdate

ProjectListRead.description: A row of the projects list: the project plus its budget figures (computed, never stored).
ProjectListRead.title: ProjectListRead

SheetsIssue.description:
« Fiches PDF » (ADR-0022): an official diffusion or a working document, on one or two
papers (tinted for the screen, white for a printer), options included or not.
SheetsIssue.title: SheetsIssue

SummaryRowRead.description: One row of a compilation (by location, zone, family, type or supplier).
SummaryRowRead.title: SummaryRowRead

post.description:
From the extension: the page as displayed (multipart `url`, `html` as a file part — a form
field is capped at 1 Mo by Starlette, a rendered page is often bigger — optional `image`).
From the extension, for each photo the server could not download (`url` = its address).
201 when the bytes are new, 200 when the same sha256 already exists (same body).

get.description: The column catalogue, in printing order, with its French labels.

post.description: The option becomes an independent article, unassigned (ADR-0021).
An existing article of the project becomes an option of this one (ADR-0021).
This option takes its base's place (ADR-0021); returns the option, now the base.

« Enregistrer » on the article page: sheet, status, placements, files and options at once,
all or nothing.

delete.description: Takes the last official diffusion back (ADR-0022): indices and rules as before it.

get.description:
Listing PDF: the columns of listing profile `profile` (ADR-0023), all of them without;
the options only with `options=true`.

post.description:
« Fiches PDF » (ADR-0022): issues the sheets on each paper asked, as an official diffusion
(indices moved) or a working document; the PDFs are then downloaded from `/files/{id}`.
`fileId`: an uploaded image, or a PDF whose first page is drawn.

get.description: Every sheet of the project, or of one room with `locationId`.
